title: 2020年12月 第1套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A poisonous fish which has a sting strong enough to kill a human is invading the Mediterranean, warn scientists.
lines.translation: 一条有毒的鱼 其刺力足以杀死人类 正在入侵地中海 警告科学家们

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The International Union for Conservation of Nature has raised concerns after the poisonous fish was spotted in the waters around Turkey, Cyprus, and the eastern Mediterranean.
lines.translation: 国际自然保护联盟在土耳其、塞浦路斯和东地中海水域发现有毒鱼类后,对此表示关切。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks and a painful sting capable of killing people.
lines.translation: 可能致命的鱼在南太平洋和印度洋的原生地有有毒的钩子和痛苦的刺痛,能够杀人。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Although fatalities are rare, the stings can cause extreme pain and stop people breathing.
lines.translation: 虽然死亡是罕见的,但疼痛可造成极端痛苦,使人们停止呼吸。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The fish, often known as Devil Firefish, is a highly invasive species, and environmentalists fear its arrival could endanger other types of marine life.
lines.translation: 这些鱼类,通常被称为 " 魔鬼火鱼 " ,是一种高度侵入性物种,环境学家担心其到来会危及其他种类的海洋生物。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After being spotted in the Mediterranean, a marine scientist says, "The fish is spreading, and that's a cause for concern."
lines.translation: 一名海洋科学家在地中海被发现后说, “鱼在扩散,这令人担心。”

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 1. What is reported in the news?
lines.translation: 第 1 题：新闻报道了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What is the environmentalist concerned about the spread of Devil Firefish in the Mediterranean?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：环保主义者对魔鬼火鱼在地中海扩散有何担忧?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Almost half the center of Paris will be accessible only by foot or bicycle this Sunday to mark World Car Free Day.
lines.translation: 本周日，巴黎市中心近一半的区域将仅允许步行或骑自行车通行，以纪念世界无车日。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is in response to rising air pollution that made Paris the most polluted city in the world for a brief time.
lines.translation: 这是对日益严重的空气污染的回应，空气污染曾一度使巴黎成为世界上污染最严重的城市。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mayor Anne Hidalgo promoted the first World Car-Free Day last year.
lines.translation: 市长Anne Hidalgo在去年推动了首个世界无车日。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hidalgo also has supported a "Paris Breathes" day.
lines.translation: Hidalgo还支持"巴黎呼吸"日。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: On the first Sunday of every month, Paris clears traffic from eight lanes of the main road.
lines.translation: 每月的第一个周日,巴黎会清空主干道八条车道的交通。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: About 400 miles of streets will be closed to cars.
lines.translation: 约400英里的街道将禁止汽车通行。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It is expected to bring significant reduction in pollution levels.
lines.translation: 预计这将显著降低污染水平。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Last year's car-free day showed a 40 percent drop in pollution levels in some parts of the city, according to an independent air pollution monitor, reports The Guardian—and sound levels dropped by 50 percent in the city's center.
lines.translation: 据《卫报》报道，根据一家独立空气污染监测机构的数据，去年的无车日使该市部分地区的污染水平下降了40%，市中心的噪音水平下降了50%。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What will happen on World Car-Free Day in Paris?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：巴黎的世界无车日将会发生什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What motivated the mayor of Paris to promote the first World Car-Free Day in her city?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：是什么促使巴黎市长在她的城市推动首个世界无车日?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Report 3.
lines.translation: 报告3。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A Philippine fisherman was feeling down on his luck when a house fire forced him to clear out his possessions and change locations.
lines.translation: 一名菲律宾渔民在遭遇房屋火灾时感到运气不好,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Then a good luck charm that he had kept under his bed changed his life.
lines.translation: 然后,他把一个幸运符放在床底下 改变了他的生活

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The unidentified man had fished out a giant pearl from the ocean when his anchor got stuck on the rock while sailing off the coastal island in the Philippines ten years ago.
lines.translation: 10年前他的船锚被卡在岩石上 并驶离菲律宾沿海岛屿 之后 不明身份的人从海洋中捕出了一只巨大的珍珠

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: When he was forced to sell it, the shocked tourist agent at Puerto Princesa told him that the 77-pound giant pearl that he'd kept hidden in his run-down wooden house was the biggest pearl in the world, which was valued at 76 million pounds.
lines.translation: 当他被迫卖掉它时,Puerto Printsa的令人震惊的旅游代理告诉他,他藏在破烂木屋里的77磅大珍珠是世界上最大的珍珠,价值7 600万英镑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The pearl of Allah, which is currently on display in a New York museum only weighs 14 pounds.
lines.translation: 目前在纽约博物馆展出的阿拉之珍珠只有14磅重。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That is 5 times smaller than the pearl that the fisherman just handed in.
lines.translation: 那比渔夫刚交出的珍珠小五倍

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The monstrous pearl measured at one foot wide and 2.2 feet long is going to be verified by local experts and international authorities before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists in the little town.
lines.translation: 以一英尺宽和2.2英尺长测量的可怕珍珠将由当地专家和国际主管部门核实,然后有望展出,吸引这个小城镇更多的游客。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. What happened to the Philippine fisherman one day?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：菲律宾渔民有一天发生了什么事？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 6. What was the fisherman forced to do?
lines.translation: 第 6 题：这位渔民被迫做什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 7. What did the fisherman learn from the tourist agent?
lines.translation: 第 7 题：渔民从旅游代理那里了解到什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section, you'll hear two long conversations.
lines.translation: 在这一节里,你会听到两个长长的谈话。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each conversation,
lines.translation: 每次谈话结束时

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: you will hear four questions.
lines.translation: 你会听到四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 谈话和问题只谈一次

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C and D.
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案,这四个选择分别是A、B、C和D。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation one.
lines.translation: 交谈之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Mr. Smith, it's a pleasure meeting you.
lines.translation: 史密斯先生 很高兴见到你

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nice to meet you, too.
lines.translation: 我也很高兴见到你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: What can I do for you?
lines.translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, I'm here to show you what our firm can do for you.
lines.translation: 嗯，我来这儿是想向您展示我们公司能为您做些什么。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Astra Consultants has branches in over 50 countries, offering different business services.
lines.translation: Astra咨询公司在50多个国家设有分支机构，提供各种商业服务。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We are a global company with 75 years of history, and our clients include some of the world's largest companies.
lines.translation: 我们是一家拥有75年历史的全球性公司，我们的客户包括一些世界上最大的公司。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thank you, Mrs. Houston.
lines.translation: 谢谢你,休斯顿夫人

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I know Astra Consultants is a famous company.
lines.translation: 我知道阿斯特拉咨询公司是一家著名的公司

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But you said you would show me what you could do for me.
lines.translation: 但你说过你会告诉我 你能为我做什么

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, what exactly can your firm do for my company?
lines.translation: 你们律所能为我公司做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We advise businesses on all matters, from market analysis to legal issues, anything a business like yours could need.
lines.translation: 我们建议企业从市场分析到法律问题 任何你这样的企业需要的东西

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our firm offers expert advice.
lines.translation: 我们公司提供专家意见。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Could I ask you, Mr. Smith, to tell me a little about your company and the challenges you face?
lines.translation: 我能请你,史密斯先生 谈谈你的公司 和你面临的挑战吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That way I could better respond as to how we can help you.
lines.translation: 这样我才能更好地回应 如何帮你

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Okay, sure.
lines.translation: 好的，当然。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is a family business started by my grandfather in 1950.
lines.translation: 这是我祖父在1950年创办的家族企业。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We employ just over 100 people.
lines.translation: 我们雇佣了100多名员工。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We manufacture and export stone for buildings and other constructions.
lines.translation: 我们制造和出口用于建筑和其他建设的石材。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our clients usually want a special kind of stone cut in a special design.
lines.translation: 我们的客户通常需要按特殊设计切割的特殊石材。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And that's what we do in our factory.
lines.translation: 这就是我们在工厂里做的事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our main challenge is that our national currency is rising, and we're losing competitive advantage to stone producers in India.
lines.translation: 我们面临的主要挑战是我们国家的货币在升值，我们正在失去相对于印度石材生产商的竞争优势。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I see.
lines.translation: 我明白了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's very interesting.
lines.translation: 这很有意思。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I would suggest that you let us first conduct a financial analysis of your company, together with an analysis of your competitors in India.
lines.translation: 我建议您让我们先对贵公司进行财务分析，同时分析您在印度的竞争对手。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That way we could offer the best advice on different ways forward for you.
lines.translation: 这样我们就能为您提供关于不同发展方向的最佳建议。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 8. What do we learn about the woman's company?
lines.translation: 第 8 题：关于这位女士的公司我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 9. What does the man say about his own company?
lines.translation: 第 9 题：这位男士关于他自己的公司说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 10. What is the main problem with the man's company?
lines.translation: 第 10 题：这位男士的公司面临的主要问题是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 11. What does the woman suggest doing to help the man's company?
lines.translation: 第 11 题：这位女士建议做什么来帮助这位男士的公司?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation 2.
lines.translation: 对话2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Wow,
lines.translation: 哇

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The place looks absolutely amazing!
lines.translation: 这地方看起来太棒了！

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Really?
lines.translation: 真的吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You think so?
lines.translation: 你真这么觉得？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Of course.
lines.translation: 当然了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I love it.
lines.translation: 我很喜欢。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It looks like you had a professional interior designer.
lines.translation: 看起来像是请了专业室内设计师一样。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But you didn't, did you?
lines.translation: 但你没有吧，对吧？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No.
lines.translation: 没有。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I did it all by myself with a little help from my brother Greg.
lines.translation: 我全是自己做的，我弟弟Greg帮了点忙。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He's actually in the construction business, which was really helpful.
lines.translation: 他其实是做建筑行业的，这真的帮了大忙。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I honestly am impressed.
lines.translation: 我真的很佩服。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I know I could probably repaint the walls in my house over a weekend or something, but not a full renovation.
lines.translation: 我知道我可能可以在一个周末之类的时间把家里的墙重新刷一遍，但做不了全面翻修。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Where did you get your ideas?
lines.translation: 你的想法是从哪儿来的？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I wouldn't know where to start.
lines.translation: 我都不知道从哪儿开始。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, for a while now, I've been regularly buying home design magazines.
lines.translation: 嗯，有一段时间了，我一直定期买家居设计杂志。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Every now and then, I'd save a picture I liked.
lines.translation: 时不时地，我会保存我喜欢的图片。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Believe it or not, I had a full notebook of magazine pages.
lines.translation: 信不信由你，我有满满一个笔记本的杂志页。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Since my overall style was quite minimal, I thought and hoped a whole renovation wouldn't be too difficult.
lines.translation: 因为我整体风格相当简约，我觉得也希望整体翻修不会太难。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And sure enough, with Greg's help, it was very achievable.
lines.translation: 果然，有Greg的帮忙，这很容易实现。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Was it very expensive?
lines.translation: 花费很贵吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've imagined a project like this could be.
lines.translation: 我想象这样的项目可能会很贵。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Actually it was surprisingly affordable.
lines.translation: 实际上出乎意料地便宜。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I managed to sell a lot of my old furniture and put that extra money towards the new material.
lines.translation: 我设法卖掉了很多旧家具，把那笔额外的钱用在新材料上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Greg was also able to get some discount materials from a recent project he was working on as well.
lines.translation: Greg还能从他最近做的一个项目那里弄到一些打折的材料。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Great.
lines.translation: 太好了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to pick your brains a bit more.
lines.translation: 如果你不介意的话，我想再向你请教一下。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating our sitting room, not the whole house, not yet anyway.
lines.translation: Jonathan和我正在考虑翻修我们的客厅，不是整个房子，至少现在还不是。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And we'd love to get some inspiration from your experience.
lines.translation: 我们很想从你的经验中获得一些灵感。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Are you free to come over for a coffee early next week?
lines.translation: 下周初你有空过来喝杯咖啡吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 12. What do we learn about the woman from the conversation?
lines.translation: 第 12 题：从对话中我们了解到关于这位女士的什么信息?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 13. Where did the man get his ideas for the project?
lines.translation: 第 13 题：这位男士从哪里获得了这个项目的想法?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 14. What did the man say about the project he recently completed?
lines.translation: 第 14 题：关于他最近完成的项目,这位男士说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 15. Why does the woman invite the man to her house next week?
lines.translation: 第 15 题：这位女士为什么邀请这位男士下周去她家?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Section C. Directions.
lines.translation: C节. 指示。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section...
lines.translation: 在本节...

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You'll hear three passages.
lines.translation: 你会听到三个段落。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each passage,
lines.translation: 在每个通道的尽头

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: you'll hear three or four questions.
lines.translation: 你会听到三四个问题

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 发言的通过和提问将只讲一次。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B,
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择中选择最好的答案,四个选择标注A,B,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: C and D.
lines.translation: C和D。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Removing foreign objects from ears and noses costs England almost 3 million pounds a year, a study suggests.
lines.translation: 一项研究表明,从耳朵和鼻子中移除外国物品每年花费英国近300万英镑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Children were responsible for the vast majority of cases—95% of objects removed from noses and 85% from ears.
lines.translation: 绝大多数病例是由儿童造成的——95%的鼻子和85%的耳朵被摘除。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Every year an average of 1,218 nose and 2,479 ear removals took place between 2010 and 2016.
lines.translation: 2010年至2016年期间,平均每年有1,218个鼻子和2,479个耳朵被清除。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: According to England's Hospital Episode Statistics, children aged one to four were the most likely to need help from doctors for a foreign object in their nose.
lines.translation: 根据英格兰医院的《病史统计》,一至四岁的儿童最有可能需要医生的帮助,以获得其鼻部外在物品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Five- to nine-year-olds come to the hospital with something in their ears the most.
lines.translation: 五到九岁的孩子 带着他们耳边最深的东西来到医院

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Jewellery items accounted for up to 40% of cases in both the ears and noses of children.
lines.translation: 珠宝物品占儿童耳朵和鼻部病例的40%。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Paper and plastic toys were the items removed next most from noses.
lines.translation: 纸和塑料玩具是从鼻子中取走的物品最多。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Cotton buds and pencils were also found in ears.
lines.translation: 在耳朵里还发现了棉花芽和铅笔。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: According to the study, the occurrence of foreign objects in children is generally attributed to curiosity.
lines.translation: 根据这项研究,在儿童身上出现外国物品一般归因于好奇。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears.
lines.translation: 儿童有冲动去探探他们的鼻子和耳朵。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This resulted in the accidental entry of foreign objects.
lines.translation: 这导致外国物体意外入境。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Any ear, nose and throat surgeon has many weird stories about wonderful objects found in the noses and ears of children and adults.
lines.translation: 任何耳、鼻和喉科外科医生都有许多关于儿童和成人鼻子和耳朵中发现奇妙物品的怪事。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Batteries can pose a particular danger.
lines.translation: 电池可能构成一种特别的危险。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In all cases prevention is better than cure.
lines.translation: 在所有情况下,预防胜于治疗。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is why many toys contain warnings about small parts.
lines.translation: 这就是为什么许多玩具含有关于小零件的警告。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Recognizing problems early and seeking medical attention is important.
lines.translation: 必须及早发现问题并寻求医疗照顾。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 16. What does England spend an annual three million pounds on?
lines.translation: 第 16 题：英格兰每年在什么方面花费三百万英镑？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 17. What do we learn from England's Hospital Episode Statistics?
lines.translation: 第 17 题：我们从英格兰医院事件统计中了解到什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 18. What is generally believed to account for children putting things in their ears or noses?
lines.translation: 第 18 题：人们普遍认为儿童把东西塞进耳朵或鼻子的原因是什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage 2.
lines.translation: 通行证2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Good morning.
lines.translation: 早上好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Today, I would like to talk to you about my charity ReBicycle.
lines.translation: 今天,我想和大家谈谈我的慈善组织ReBicycle。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But before that, let me introduce someone.
lines.translation: 但在此之前,让我介绍一个人。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This is Leila Rahimi.
lines.translation: 这位是Leila Rahimi。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: She was so scared when she first moved to New Zealand that she struggled to leave the house and would spend days working up the courage to walk to the supermarket for basic supplies.
lines.translation: 她刚搬到新西兰时非常害怕,以至于她很难走出家门,需要花好几天时间鼓起勇气走到超市购买基本生活用品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After a few months of being quite down and unhappy, she was invited to join a local bike club.
lines.translation: 在情绪低落和不快乐了几个月之后,她受邀加入了当地的一个自行车俱乐部。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At this time, ReBicycle got involved and gave Leila a second-hand bicycle.
lines.translation: 这时,ReBicycle介入并给了Leila一辆二手自行车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Within weeks, her depression had begun to ease as she cycled.
lines.translation: 几周之内,她的抑郁情绪开始缓解,因为她开始骑车了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The bicycle totally changed her life, giving her hope and a true feeling of freedom.
lines.translation: 自行车彻底改变了她的生活,给了她希望和真正的自由感。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: To date, ReBicycle has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need, and is now expanding bike-riding lessons as demand soars.
lines.translation: 迄今为止,ReBicycle已向有需要的人捐赠了200多辆自行车,并且随着需求激增,现在正在扩大自行车骑行课程。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: With a bike, newcomers here can travel farther but for almost no cost.
lines.translation: 有了自行车,这里的新移民可以走得更远,但几乎不需要花费任何成本。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The three hours a day, they used to spend walking to and from English language lessons, have been reduced to just one hour.
lines.translation: 他们过去每天花三个小时步行往返英语课程,现在已经减少到只需一个小时。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Our bike-riding lessons are so successful that we are urgently looking for more volunteers.
lines.translation: 我们的自行车骑行课程非常成功,我们迫切需要更多志愿者。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Learning to ride a bike is almost always more difficult for an adult, and this can take days and weeks, rather than hours.
lines.translation: 对成年人来说,学习骑自行车几乎总是更困难,这可能需要几天甚至几周的时间,而不是几个小时。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So if any of you have some free time during the weekend, please come join us at ReBicycle and make a difference in someone's life.
lines.translation: 所以如果你们中有人在周末有空闲时间,请来加入我们ReBicycle,为他人的生活带来改变。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 19. What did ReBicycle do to help Leila Rahimi?
lines.translation: 第 19 题：ReBicycle 做了什么来帮助 Leila Rahimi?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 20. What is ReBicycle doing to help those in need?
lines.translation: 第 20 题：ReBicycle 正在做什么来帮助那些有需要的人?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 21. What do we learn from the passage about ReBicycle?
lines.translation: 第 21 题：我们从文章中了解到关于 ReBicycle 的什么信息?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage 3.
lines.translation: 通行证3。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thanks to the International Space Station, we know quite a bit about the effects of low gravity on the human body.
lines.translation: 多亏了国际空间站,我们相当了解 低重力对人体的影响。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: To that end, they have been studying how other species deal with low gravity, specifically focusing on mice.
lines.translation: 为此，他们一直在研究其他物种如何应对低重力环境，特别关注小鼠。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The results are both interesting and humorous.
lines.translation: 研究结果既有趣又幽默。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The scientists first sent some mice in a specially designed cage to the International Space Station.
lines.translation: 科学家们首先将一些小鼠装在specially designed的笼子里送往国际空间站。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The cage allowed them to study the behavior of the mice remotely from Earth via video.
lines.translation: 这个笼子使他们能够通过视频从地球上远程研究小鼠的行为。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: As you'll notice in the video, the mice definitely seem uncomfortable at the beginning of the experiment.
lines.translation: 正如你在视频中注意到的，小鼠在实验开始时显然感到不适。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They move around clumsily, drifting within the small confines of the cage, and do their best to figure out which way is up, but without success.
lines.translation: 它们笨拙地移动，在笼子的狭小空间内漂浮，并尽最大努力搞清楚哪边是上，但没有成功。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: However, it's not long before the mice begin to catch on.
lines.translation: 然而，没过多久小鼠就开始明白了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They adapt remarkably well to their new environment and even use the lack of gravity to their advantage as they push themselves around the cage.
lines.translation: 它们非常好地适应了新环境，甚至利用失重状态的优势在笼子里推动自己移动。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's when things really get wild.
lines.translation: 这时事情变得非常有趣。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The eleventh day of the experiment shows the mice are not just dealing with the gravity change but actually seem to be enjoying it.
lines.translation: 实验的第十一天显示，小鼠不仅在应对重力变化，而且实际上似乎很享受它。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Several of the mice are observed running around the cage walls.
lines.translation: 观察到几只小鼠在笼子壁上奔跑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The scientists wanted to see whether the mice would continue doing the same kinds of activities they were observed doing on Earth.
lines.translation: 科学家们想看看小鼠是否会继续做在地球上观察到的同类活动。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The study showed that the mice kept much of their routines intact, including cleaning themselves and eating when hungry.
lines.translation: 研究表明，小鼠基本保持了它们的日常习惯，包括清洁自己和饿了就吃东西。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 22. What do NASA scientists want to learn about?
lines.translation: 第 22 题：NASA的科学家想要了解什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 23. What does the passage say about the mice at the beginning of the experiment?
lines.translation: 第 23 题：关于实验开始时的小鼠，文章说了什么？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 24. What was observed about the mice on the eleventh day of the experiment?
lines.translation: 第 24 题：实验第十一天观察到小鼠有什么表现？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 25. What did the scientists find about the mice from the experiment?
lines.translation: 第 25 题：科学家从实验中发现了小鼠的什么情况？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's the end of listening comprehension.
lines.translation: 听觉理解到此结束
